svg.text: T37 • INCIDENT POSTMORTEM
BEST FOR: AGENTOPS & KILL-SWITCH
FORMAT LINEAGE: Brij Kishore Pandey ('How Do We Turn It Off?' 5-Stage Lifecycle & Kill-Switch) • Google SRE postmortem
Postmortem & Kill-Switch: How One 429 Became an $84 Night — and the 5 Controls That Stop It
Google SRE postmortem + Brij Kishore Pandey's 'How Do We Turn It Off?' lifecycle (Register → Own → Measure → Review → Retire; 81% of CIOs lack agent oversight).
Vendor API starts returning 429 (rate limited)
The agent's create_ticket call fails with a generic error string; nothing in the harness
distinguishes 'retry later' from 'try something else'.
Agent retries the identical call
Same tool, same arguments. The model reads the error, concludes 'try again', and does — the
context barely changed.
WOULD HAVE STOPPED IT HERE: Loop circuit breaker
sha256(tool+args) seen twice in 5 turns → block the 3rd call, inject a strategy-
shift directive (ask for a different approach or escalate).
saves $83.9
48th identical retry; context full of error strings
Each turn re-reads the growing history (~20K tokens); cost per turn climbs; no step ceiling
exists.
WOULD HAVE STOPPED IT HERE: Step ceiling (max_steps=15)
ADK RunConfig / LangGraph recursion_limit / OpenHands max_iterations end the run
with a clean checkpoint at step 15.
saves $74
Billing alert fires at $84
The only control that worked was a daily budget alert — 41 minutes late.
WOULD HAVE STOPPED IT HERE: Cost ceiling + Runtime Kill-Switch
Brij Pandey's 10-Field Agent Record requires a registered kill_switch_endpoint &
named human owner before deploy; caps spend at $0.25.
caps at $0.25
On-call kills the job
No checkpoint exists; the whole task state lived in RAM.
task lost
WOULD HAVE STOPPED IT HERE: Durable step checkpoints
Firestore / PostgresSaver snapshot after every tool turn; resume at the last good
step in ~40 ms instead of restarting.
0 rework
Duplicate ticket discovered
The 1st call had actually succeeded upstream before the 429 — the retries created a second
ticket under the user's name.
customer-visible
WOULD HAVE STOPPED IT HERE: Idempotency key on every write
sha256(workflow+step+tool+args) ledger (Firestore / Redis SETNX); a repeated write
returns the cached receipt instead of acting twice.
0 duplicates
T+1 day
Blameless postmortem + 5-Stage Lifecycle
Enforce Register → Own → Measure → Review → Retire (Dataiku survey: 83% lack lifecycle
management; 47% retired >20 shadow agents).
5 actions
ACTION ITEMS (OWNER • DUE)
10-Field Agent Record (owner + kill-switch + policy gate) • platform • sprint
Loop breaker + step ceiling + $0.25 cost cap in harness • platform • sprint
Idempotency keys on writes + step checkpoints • integrations & SRE • sprint
Curated by Nitin Aggarwal • Google Cloud ADK + OpenHands Factory • Proprietary + Confidential
Brij Kishore Pandey, 'How Do We Turn It Off?' (Oct 2026; Dataiku/Harris Poll 685 CIOs) • Google SRE Book • IDEA-01 & IDEA-06
